description: This file manages the user logout process in SuiteCRM, including session termination, setting preferences, invoking hooks, and calling the logout method of the authentication controller.

classes.name: AuthenticationController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for user authentication actions, such as login and logout.

methods.name: preLogout
methods.description: Optional hook method called before user logout to perform any necessary pre-logout actions.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs the actual logout process, clearing session data, cookies, and performing any additional cleanup.
